trust_decision.summary: Whether libxml2 may resolve external (network) entities while parsing the PAM config into the user's device list; decided by the parser flags passed to xmlReadFile in pusb_conf_parse. At the pinned commit the flags are already XML_PARSE_NONET | XML_PARSE_NOENT, i.e. the advisory's fix (#385) is already present.

landing_point.why: The summary names xmlReadFile flags=0 in conf.c; it is the only libxml2 parse call in the C sources.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Code comment already argues file:// entities are out of scope because the config is root-owned (src/conf.c:239-240); a solver would dismiss anything beyond NONET the same way.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Configs using internal entity declarations must keep parsing and expanding (tested); an over-broad fix that rejects DTDs or disables entity substitution would break this.

O6_input_shapes: external SYSTEM entity with http:// URI (blocked by NONET)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second xmlReadFile/xmlReadMemory of a pad or per-user XML file with flags=0
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: pad.c already links libxml2 for tests (Makefile:122) and a maintainer could plausibly read auxiliary XML with default flags; not verified that pad.c parses XML itself.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A CLI-only config reload path parsing an alternate --config file with its own xmlReadFile call
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: pamusb-check is a separate binary that takes a config path; a duplicated parse helper there would be a natural second implementation.

O10_build.toolchain: gcc, make, pkg-config, libxml2-dev, libpam, libevdev, cmocka; Python 3 for tools tests
O10_build.project_tests: make test-c-conf (tests/unit/c/conf_test.c, includes XXE tests at tests/unit/c/conf_test.c:369-458); Makefile:135, Makefile:185-190

j.j_sites_touched: none (fix commit changes only ChangeLog, SECURITY.md, packaging, doc, src/version.h, tools/pamusb-conf version string)
j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add XML_PARSE_NONET to the single xmlReadFile call in src/conf.c (already done at the pinned commit).

out_of_scope_notes: Listed fix commit d4083e2 is the 0.9.2 release-prep commit; its only source change is src/version.h (fix.diff:195-206). The real XXE fix (#385, fix.diff:18) predates the pinned commit and is already at src/conf.c:244.
XML_PARSE_NOENT with libxml2's default loader still lets local file:// SYSTEM entities through; the code says this is accepted (src/conf.c:239-242). Different property, not pursued.

Python tools parse the same config with minidom (tools/pamusb-conf:120,283,344) and ElementTree (tools/pamusb-agent:204); stdlib parsers do not fetch external entities by default, so no network-entity route is open; entity-expansion DoS is out of scope.
